insight: Founded by the team behind Wit.ai, the speech startup Facebook acquired in 2015; raised a $70M Series C in 2025.
name: Nabla
tagline: An ambient AI assistant that drafts clinical notes from patient visits.
description: Nabla is an ambient AI assistant that listens to patient visits (with consent) and generates structured clinical notes, with dictation and real-time coding support. It integrates with major EHRs, supports 35+ languages, and offers a plug-and-play module for connecting to any EHR. It is sold to health systems and provider groups.
edge: EHR-agnostic ambient scribe — its Nabla Connect module drops into any EHR, versus Epic-only or single-EHR scribes.
cons: Sold to health systems, not solo clinicians
